cleavage_agent.evidence: Trypsin was defined as the digesting enzyme, allowing a maximum of two missed cleavages and requiring a minimum length of 6 amino acids.

collision_energy.evidence: The mass spectrometer was operated in the positive ion mode, switching in a data-dependent fashion between survey scans in the orbitrap (mass range m/z = 350-1400; resolution R=60000; target value = 3E6; max IT 100 ms) and MS/MS acquisition (HCD) of the 20 most intense ion peaks detected (resolution R = 15.000; target value = 1E5; max IT = 15msec; NCE = 27).

enrichment_method.evidence: Following peptide elution and lyophilization, peptides were then TMT labeled and desalted, followed by phosphopeptide enrichment on Fe-NTA spin columns (Thermo Scientific).

fractionation_method.evidence: Unbound peptides were lyophilized and offline fractionated by high pH reversed phase HPLC (YMC Triart C18 column, 250 x 4.6 mm ID) into 60 fractions for the subsequent measurements of the total proteomes.

fragmentation_method.evidence: The mass spectrometer was operated in the positive ion mode, switching in a data-dependent fashion between survey scans in the orbitrap (mass range m/z = 350-1400; resolution R=60000; target value = 3E6; max IT 100 ms) and MS/MS acquisition (HCD) of the 20 most intense ion peaks detected (resolution R = 15.000; target value = 1E5; max IT = 15msec; NCE = 27).

ionization_type.evidence: Briefly, peptide samples were reversed-phase separated on a fused silica capillary column (length 25 cm; ID 75 μm; Dr. Maisch ReproSil-Pur C18-AQ, 1.9 μm) using an Easy nLC 1200 nanoflow system that was online coupled via a Nanospray Flex ion source to an Orbitrap HF mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific).
